name: model-crosscheck
description: Multi-model adversarial workflows for Claude Code: Claude + OpenAI Codex CLI (+ optionally Google Gemini) as independent critics on the same plan, diff, architecture choice, or business decision.

plugins.name: crosscheck
plugins.description: Multi-model workflows for Claude Code: /dual-plan and /tri-plan (rival models critique a plan until convergence), /dual-review and /tri-review (independent reviewers on the same diff), /tri-decide (architecture decisions), /tri-strategy (business decisions from three assigned lenses), and /tri-research (a claim ledger two rival models re-fetch and try to break).
